flows.title: Create a form
steps: Click the Forms tab to open the Workspace.
Click + Create form, then Start from scratch.
In the builder, pick a question type from the question menu, then type the question in the Your question here field.
To add another question, click + Add content and choose the next question type.

flows.title: Share a form by link
steps: The form must be live first: click Share in the top right corner to publish it.
Open the form and click the Share panel.
Click Copy link. Anyone who opens the link can see and respond to the form.

flows.title: View responses
steps: Open the form, click the Results panel, then the Responses tab.
Responses are shown in a table sorted by date, latest first.
To see one response in detail, hover over it and click the expand icon. Use the arrow icons to move between responses.
